description: Defines the InvokableMethodProxyBase class, which serves as a base for proxy objects representing invokable methods within the Orleans code generation framework. The class encapsulates metadata about the proxy, including its associated code generator, unique identifier, base type, extension status, composite alias components, and a dictionary of invokable base types for different return types.

classes.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
classes.description: Represents the proxy base for an invokable method in Orleans, providing metadata needed for code generation and method invocation handling.

methods.name: InvokableMethodProxyBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy base with a code generator, descriptor, and a dictionary of invokable base types.
